Description: This registry defines NVIDIA factory-reset messages.

AttestedWipeFailed.Description: Indicates that an attested wipe failed.
AttestedWipeFailed.Resolution: Read the error in this message, correct that condition, and retry the attested wipe.

AttestedWipeSucceeded.Description: Indicates that an attested wipe completed successfully.

FactoryResetIgnored.Description: Indicates that a factory reset was ignored because the reset button was released early.
FactoryResetIgnored.Message: Factory reset ignored. Button released before %1 seconds.
FactoryResetIgnored.Resolution: Hold the factory reset button for the required time to schedule a factory reset.

FactoryResetScheduled.Description: Indicates that a factory reset was scheduled because the reset button was held.
FactoryResetScheduled.Message: Factory reset scheduled. Button held for %1 seconds.

Name: NVIDIA Factory Reset Message Registry
